actual_scope: Prove strict negative correlation, with relative deficit greater than q^(-m), for two full-guard corank-one requests with orthogonal kernels over every finite field and every m>=2.
scope_change_reason: This takes explicit Open next question 1 of PR4747 as original algebraic work rather than formalizing or auditing an existing result. It is a counting side result, not a mechanism or supplier admission.
bottleneck_link: Shared-header pricing cannot multiply the individual full-guard densities. The new inequality gives an all-field obstruction to that independence assumption; physical caller costs remain unknown.
stop_rule: Stop immediately at the first proved all-field inequality; package its proof and exact finite corroboration without extending to larger families.
evidence: PROOF.md derives J < (1-q^(-m))p^2 from two cited formulas and positive factorizations. verify.py checks the polynomial identity, 4032 integer parameter pairs, three cited numerical fixtures and explicit mutation/domain controls.
